device_scale_factor.description: Device scale factor: a screenshot has screen_width times this value in pixels. To mimic a retina screen, set it to 2.

video_codec.description: Codec to encode the video. Use "copy" to copy the stream without re-encoding.

fit.description: Sets the mode of sizing the video. "Max" resizes the video to fit within the width and height, but will not increase the size of the image if it is smaller than width or height. "Crop" resizes the video to fill the width and height dimensions and crops any excess video data. "Scale" enforces the video width and height by scaling. "Pad" resizes the video to the width and height dimensions and keeps the aspect ratio by adding black bars if necessary.

keyframe_interval.description: Set the number of frames after a keyframe is inserted at least.

aspect_ratio.description: Change the video aspect ratio, for example to 16:9 or 4:3.

audio_codec.description: Codec to encode the audio. Use "copy" to copy the stream without re-encoding.

volume.description: Change the audio volume, whereas 1.0 is the current volume. Example: a value of 1.1 increases the volume by 10%.

channels.description: Set the number of audio channels. Example: a value of 1 converts the file to mono.

sample_rate.description: Set the audio sampling frequency in Hz, for example 48000 or 44100.

video_codec.description: Codec to encode the video. Use "copy" to copy the stream without re-encoding.

crf.description: The Constant Rate Factor (CRF) sets the quality of the video. The range of the CRF scale is 0–51, where 0 is lossless, 23 is the default, and 51 is worst quality possible.

preset.description: The preset is a collection of options that will provide a certain encoding speed to compression ratio.

tune.description: Settings based upon the specifics of your input.

profile.description: Set output to a specific H264 compatibility profile.

level.description: Set output to a specific H264 compatibility profile level.
